A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT WONDER

Before you
say hello.

Still have a question?
The clinic is a phone call away.

How do I book an appointment?

Call +92 334 9066826 or use the appointment form to prepare a WhatsApp enquiry. The clinic will confirm a suitable date and time directly with you.

What does a consultation cost?

Please contact the clinic for current consultation fees. Treatment costs depend on your examination and the care recommended for you.

Can I come in with tooth pain?

Call the clinic, explain your concern and ask about the earliest available appointment. Same-day availability must be confirmed directly with the clinic.

Where exactly is the clinic?

The practice is in Flat 201 on the second floor of Sheikh Yaseen Trade Centre, at Arbab Road Stop on University Road in Tehkal, Peshawar. Use the directions button above to open Google Maps.

What should I bring to my first visit?

Bring any relevant dental records or recent X-rays you already have, and a list of any medicines you take. Ask the clinic if anything else is needed when booking.
